identity.title: A Spatially Resolved [C II] Survey of 31 z ∼ 7 Massive Galaxies Hosting Luminous Quasars

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present a survey of the [C II] emission lines and FIR continua of 31 luminous quasars at $z>6.5$ using the Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) and the NOrthern Extended Millimeter Array (NOEMA) at sub-arcsec resolution.

evidence.quote: In this paper, we present an overview of our spatially resolved [C II] survey of 31 luminous $z\sim7$ quasars and discuss the properties of quasar host galaxies based on [C II] and dust emission.

findings_qualitative.value: Continuum emission more concentrated than [C II]; [C II] deficit similar to local IR-luminous galaxies

evidence.quote: In general, the continuum emission is more concentrated than the [C II] emission

claims.hypothesis: Do quasar luminosity and host [C II]/FIR luminosity correlate?
claims.experiment: Spearman tests on this work plus literature

evidence.quote: Both $L_{\rm [CII]}$ and $L_{\rm FIR}$ are correlated ($\rho\simeq0.4$) with the quasar bolometric luminosity, albeit with substantial scatter.

claims.hypothesis: What are the kinematics of z~7 quasar hosts?
claims.finding: diverse kinematics, rest dispersion-dominated or disturbed

evidence.quote: About $40$% of the quasar host galaxies show a velocity gradient in [C II] emission

claims.hypothesis: Are SMBHs overmassive relative to local M_BH-M_dyn?
claims.finding: overmassive BHs with large scatter and uncertainty

evidence.quote: the ratio between $M_{\rm BH}$ and $M_{\rm dyn}$ is about ten times higher than that of local $M_{\rm BH}-M_{\rm dyn}$ relation on average

why_this_method.value: Imaging at natural weighting to maximize S/N and follow Decarli18 for comparison

evidence.quote: to maximize the signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) of our observations

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Haro 11 template luminosities not used in later analyses; graybody preferred as more widely used

evidence.quote: Since the modified graybody has been more broadly used in the literature, we only use the luminosities derived from the graybody fitting in the following analyses.

limitations_admitted.value: Marginal resolution, assumed T_dust, and uncertain inclination give large uncertainties in M_dyn and SFR

evidence.quote: We emphasize that the $M_{\rm dyn}$ estimated from both equations have large uncertainties
